Only your choices on this page and, if you add it, the encrypted Claude key. Screens, audio, conversations and translations stay in memory during the session and disappear when you stop.
Made by Brayan, Carlos, Sante and Tiago Morocini. On-device translation with Google ML Kit; optional refined translation with Claude, by Anthropic.
Theme, sizes, languages, style and quality go back to default. The Claude key isn\'t deleted; use the Claude page for that.
See you tomorrow at the station!

In screen translation with the \"Quality\" setting: the sentences on the screen go together, with context, and come back translated the way a person would. In the floating window, also when you tap a sentence to understand what it means.
The model is Claude Haiku 5.5, the most economical one. A full screen costs about US$ 0.00025, and an hour of continuous use is around US$ 0.10–0.15. The app shows the real cost of each session.

Only the text read from the screen is sent, never the image or the audio. Anthropic deletes this data within 30 days and, by default, doesn\'t use it to train models. Without internet or after an error, the app falls back to offline translation.
Translates the screen with context, understands slang and explains sentences when you tap them. Uses your own Anthropic key and only works online; without a key, everything stays offline.
To translate with Claude, choose the \"Quality\" setting on the Screen page. In the floating window, tap-to-explain works at any quality.
Tip: set a monthly spending limit in the Anthropic Console (Settings → Limits).
The key is deleted from this device and the app goes back to offline-only translation.
With Claude on, the text read from the screen (never the image or the audio) is sent to Anthropic to be translated or explained.
Anthropic deletes this data within 30 days and, by default, doesn\'t use it to train models.
Avoid Quality mode on screens with passwords, bank details or private conversations.
The cost goes to your key\'s account. With Claude Haiku 5.5, an hour of continuous use is around US$ 0.10–0.15.
Create a key at console.anthropic.com → API Keys and paste it here. It stays encrypted on this device only.
Last warning: %1$s. Affected lines use offline translation.
No calls yet. Claude translates in Quality mode and explains when you tap a line in the floating window.
EasyApp translates on the device itself. What appears on the screen, the audio and the translations only last for the session and are deleted when you stop.
We\'ll ask for the microphone (for voice conversation and, if you turn them on, audio captions) and notifications (so you can see and stop the session at any time).
Screen capture and the window over other apps are requested separately, only when you use Screen mode.
EasyApp will use the microphone to hear each turn. When the phone has the offline language pack, speech is processed without internet.
Transcripts and translations only last for the session and are deleted when you stop.
Android will ask for permission to share the screen. Visible text is read and translated on the device.
The audio captions you turned on use the microphone and need Android 13 or later. Some apps block sound capture; in those cases text translation keeps working.
Android will ask for permission to share the screen. Visible text is read and translated, and the translation appears over the screen in the style you chose.
Apps with content protection (like some video and banking apps) may appear black and won\'t be translated.
Parts stay in memory only and disappear when you stop.
Optional. Only works when the source app allows capture; screen text is translated either way.
Android asks for screen capture permission when you start.
The app follows your phone\'s language unless you pick one here. The languages you translate are chosen on each mode\'s page.
On Android 12 or earlier, the app follows the phone\'s language. To change it, change the phone\'s language in Android Settings.
